name: siga-validador
description: Extensão do Chrome que confere as despesas do SIGA contra as notas fiscais anexadas.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo ok
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../../siga-validador-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip .
